title: Introduction to R
text:
A warm welcome to our new mini-workshop series “Basic Biostatistics & Bioinformatics”, where SLUBI and SLU’s Center for Statistics collaborate to bring you a mix of theoretical background and practical coding on a variety of topics.
This session we start the series with an Introduction to R.
If you want to code along please bring your own laptop with R and R-studio installed.

title: 3B's Workshop Series
text:
About the series
The 3 Bees — Basic Biostatistics & Bioinformatics is a series of short lectures and hands-on tutorials that introduce topics and methods to help with your research projects, especially (but not only) bioinformatics. It is a collaboration between SLU’s Center for Statistics and SLUBI, SLU’s bioinformatics infrastructure.
Every session is beginner-friendly — come to just listen, or bring a laptop and follow along. Slides, tutorials, and code from each session are collected here.
